messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a spike of 5xxs from ml-service tokenizer in eu-west1, looks like OOM on recent model run. Need a small hotpatch to pin tokenizer to a known-safe build and push asap.
marta: copy, what's the target pin?
sam: we have a change window til 22:00 UTC, can we ship within that?
alex: target pin v2.1.3 (candidate). I'll request expedited canary.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: hotpatch/tokenizer-pin -> v2.1.3. Initiating staged canary in eu-west1. Canary size: 5 instances. Expected duration ~10m.
deploy-bot: release_notes: "Pin tokenizer to v2.1.3 to avoid OOM regression. No schema changes. Rolling canary then gradual rollout."
marta: infra ok with pin but want enforced rollback policy (err% threshold).
sre-oncall: I'm monitoring. Recommend rollback if 1%+ errors sustained for 2m or latency > 2x baseline p95.
lisa-product: change window is open, product ok with expedited.
alex: can we pin commit hash as well? sha: abcdef1234
marta: yes please include sha. Also add canary gating: 0->5 -> 25% -> 100% only if canary shows no error spike.
deploy-bot: updated: canary gating set. Rollback policy: error_rate>1% over 120s -> automatic rollback. Latency fallback: manual review if p95 > 2x.
alex: adding release note snippet and customer-facing blurb. ```release_notes:
- Pin tokenizer to v2.1.3 (sha: abcdef1234)
- Canary gating: 5 -> 25% -> 100%
- Auto-rollback: err>1% sustained for 120s
- No user-facing schema changes
```
deploy-bot: canary deployed: 5/5 healthy. Advancing to 25% (25 instances).
sre-oncall: seeing p50 increase ~60ms -> 80ms, p95 stable. No error spike. That's within tolerance.
alex: good, proceed to 100% when canary stabilizes.
deploy-bot: advancing to 100%, rolling out remaining instances.
product-ops: will prepare a short blurb for customers noting tokenizer pin and that no API change was required.
sam: approving expedited push. :thumbsup:
marta: infra gives final sign-off.
deploy-bot: rollout complete at 2356789060. No rollback triggered.
sre-oncall: monitoring continues, will close once 30m stable.
alex: thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the post-deploy note and add the pin to the release notes. :rocket:
product-ops: noted, will include the blurb in the release notes and notify CS.
marta: leaving a TODO for ops checklist entry: ensure quantization config doesn't drift after pin.
alex: added to tracking ticket. Closing thread once metrics stable.
